correct.text: Rulers are used to measure small to medium-sized objects in either millimetres or centimetres.
Tape measures are used to measure longer lengths in either centimetres or metres.

instruction.text: Which measuring tool should be used? Drag the scenarios to the correct measuring tools.

hint.text: Tape measures are used to measure much longer lengths in either cm or m. Rulers are used to measure shorter lengths up to one metre in either cm or mm.
hint.sound: Tape measures are used to measure longer lengths in either centimetres or metres. Rulers are used to measure shorter lengths up to one metre in either centimetres or millimetres.
